Update on MM Issues
Maintenance discovered that the spacers for the pouch-grabbing arms were missing. This appears to be the root cause of the alignment issues on MM3, which required all of the arms to be realigned and will now need to be realigned again.
The MM4 X-ray is now fully operational. Troy performed a hard reset, and the system resumed normal functionality. Reject timing has been corrected, and products are now being rejected as intended.
